title: J-1 Au Pair Exchange Visitor Program
description: A federally regulated, year-long cultural exchange program (part of the U.S. Department of State's BridgeUSA Exchange Visitor Program) in which participants aged 18-26 from a participating country live with an American host family and provide up to 45 hours of childcare per week (max 10 hours/day) in exchange for a Department-of-State-mandated minimum weekly stipend of USD 195.75, plus room and board and a USD 500 education allowance toward required coursework. Participants must enroll in at least 6 semester hours at a U.S. post-secondary accredited institution during their year. The program is governed by federal regulation (22 CFR Section 62.31) and administered through twelve State-Department-designated sponsor organizations rather than a single application portal; applications are accepted on a rolling, year-round basis rather than against a fixed annual deadline. Placement location within the U.S. depends on the matched host family. The J-1 visa itself is arranged as part of the placement process through the sponsor organization.
org: U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs (BridgeUSA)
visaNote: The required J-1 exchange visitor visa is arranged as part of placement through one of the twelve State-Department-designated sponsor organizations, not self-sponsored by the applicant.
